description.purpose: Scope marker of the session keeper: bundles the channel-generation state and the two passes that move it -- the stamp in the ingress path and the nightly close -- behind one entry lane and two exit routes. A session is a phone call on a channel: it begins with a turn, it ends deterministically, and everything downstream only reads the id.
description.use_when: One per agent surface, in front of the context assembly. Instantiate it in the same mutation that wires the ingress lane and the close port; the keeper is an island until an edge crosses into it.
description.not_in_scope: No conversation content and no context assembly -- the turns live in the collector's window. No judgement about whether a conversation is over: the close is a timer plus an idle threshold, never a model call. Nothing is deleted; a closed generation stays as a row.
